sessionTitle: Data Science & Machine Learning with Microsoft Fabric

announcements.name: Fabric Data Agent consumption surfaces
announcements.shortDescription: Once published, a Fabric Data Agent is accessible as an MCP server endpoint and can be integrated with Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Microsoft Foundry
announcements.longDescription: Once a Fabric data agent is created, it can be accessed as an MCP server endpoint. It can also be deployed on Microsoft 365 Copilot [inferred] and integrated with Microsoft Foundry as well as Copilot Studio. The Fabric data agent lets users execute natural-language queries against data in OneLake, converting them into corresponding SQL statements based on provided instructions and returning the information.

announcements.name: Operational agent in preview
announcements.shortDescription: An operational agent (distinct from the data agent) is available in preview to monitor real-time data and recommend business actions
announcements.longDescription: In addition to the data agent, there is another agent called the operational agent, which is under preview. It can be used to monitor real-time data and recommend business actions. In the demo the speaker instead proceeds with the sales data agent for generating insights from sales data tables.
